candidates.change_summary: Replaced call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a zero-value withdraw(0) so withdrawAll no longer forwards contract balance to owner.

Removed the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll, allowing any caller to invoke withdrawAll and cause funds to be withdrawn to the caller (msg.sender) instead of the original owner check preventing that.

Changed require in onlyOwner to require(msg.sender != owner) which flips the guard, allowing only non-owners to pass and thereby preventing the original owner from calling withdrawAll while allowing others to do so.
Replace transfer to send, which changes failure/return behavior and can alter whether funds are reverted or not when withdrawing.
Use call with empty data and propagate success check, allowing more gas and different failure semantics compared to transfer.
Weaken onlyOwner to allow anyone to call owner-restricted functions, changing who can invoke withdraw and thus observed behavior.
Replace low-level call with a call that checks the return value and reverts on failure, which can prevent depositsCount changes in fallback of target from persisting due to revert.
Replace call with transfer, which forwards only 2300 gas and may prevent the target's fallback from incrementing depositsCount if it needs more gas.
Replace call with a call that sends zero value regardless of _value, changing whether target's fallback receives Ether and thus its observable state.
Relax onlyOwner to allow anyone to call guarded functions by removing the require, changing accessibility and thus who can trigger sendMoney effects.
